DISTORTION_WORLD.reason: Platinum explicitly has no ordinary wild Pokémon in the Distortion World. Its emptiness is preserved as part of the area identity.

scripted_static.role: Mandatory story/static encounter at the end of the Distortion World

DISTORTION_WORLD.retry_policy: Mercury QoL: if Giratina is defeated or the player flees, the story encounter remains recoverable before the League rather than becoming a postgame-only loss. Exact reset/respawn script is staged for the final Distortion World map implementation.
DISTORTION_WORLD.time_policy: The global clock continues to exist for save/evolution systems, but Distortion World has no day/night encounter tables because it has no random encounters.
DISTORTION_WORLD.lake_guardians: Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf are story guides/puzzle actors here, not random encounters.
DISTORTION_WORLD.cyrus: Final Cyrus battle remains a scripted boss encounter before Giratina.

TURNBACK_CAVE_FUTURE_POLICY.note: Do not use Turnback Cave to justify random Distortion World encounters. It will receive its own Platinum-based cave audit later, including pre-League availability decisions needed by Mercury’s all-supported-Pokémon-before-postgame policy.

ROUTE_222.identity: Southeastern Sinnoh coastal route into Sunyshore. Platinum electric/coastal anchors remain, while Mercury adds evolved late-game electric and shoreline species instead of recycling Route 218/213 wholesale.

Flaaffy/Skitty special encounter ideas from Platinum are not required as randomizer gates; Mercury uses authored TOD/rare distribution instead.
Honey is instant in Mercury: one Honey triggers one immediate premium encounter with no wait or cooldown.

SUNYSHORE_CITY.identity: Sunyshore itself has no random land encounters. Its harbor/sea water is a late-game coastal fishery connected to Route 222.
notes: Platinum Sunyshore water uses Tentacool/Wingull/Tentacruel/Pelipper as its core; Mercury expands the connected harbor ecology without inventing city grass encounters.

design_rules: Distortion World has no random wild encounters; Giratina Origin is a scripted static encounter.
Route 222 preserves Platinum electric/coastal anchors and Chatot day/night behavior.
Route 222 must feel distinct from Route 213 and Route 218 by emphasizing late-game evolved Electric species.
Sunyshore has no random land table; water/fishing only.
No Great Marsh Safari-exclusive species are reused as ordinary Route 222/Sunyshore catches.
Honey Tree remains instant and premium.

ROUTE_217.identity: Deep-blizzard tundra. Platinum Snover/Swinub/Sneasel/Snorunt identity; Mercury expands with harsher Ice species distinct from Route 216.

icy_rock.purpose: Glaceon evolution landmark; do not replace with a generic item trigger.

ACUITY_LAKEFRONT.identity: High-elevation snow shelf at the Lake Acuity approach. Platinum Snover/Swinub/Sneasel backbone; Mercury emphasizes evolved cold-climate species.
notes: Glaceon is a very rare wild reward here, while the Route 217 Icy Rock remains the normal evolution landmark.

LAKE_ACUITY.identity: Northern lake-edge snow-and-water habitat. Platinum Snover/Bibarel/Golduck/Sneasel/Psyduck backbone retained.

cave.note: Uxie remains a static/story encounter rather than a generic cave wild table.

SNOWPOINT_CITY.note: No wild table is invented for the city itself. Snowpoint's encounter identity belongs to its surrounding routes/lake unless a later Platinum map source explicitly supports otherwise.

diversification_rules: Adjacent northern areas share only ecologically necessary Platinum anchors; Mercury additions are intentionally different by biome.
Great Marsh Safari-exclusive foreign rares remain reserved and are not reused as ordinary northern-route catches.
Fuego Ironworks remains an optional side-area with a Fire/Electric/industrial identity rather than a substitute for normal route Fire availability.
No player-facing geography is derived from Emerald/Hoenn; runtime wiring waits for actual Sinnoh maps.

safari_exclusive_policy.purpose: Each Great Marsh biome has a distinct pool of foreign Safari rares unavailable on ordinary authored Sinnoh routes.

IRON_ISLAND_REGISTRY_2026-09-05.json.design_source: Pokemon Platinum Iron Island, expanded for Mercury Redux
IRON_ISLAND_REGISTRY_2026-09-05.json.source_rule: Platinum/Sinnoh defines geography, ecology, Riley progression, and encounter anchors. Emerald-derived identifiers are hidden engine implementation only and are not content sources.

outside.note: Platinum Iron Island outside has water/fishing encounters but no ordinary grass/cave land table.

1F.identity: Abandoned mine entrance; Platinum Geodude/Graveler/Zubat/Golbat/Onix backbone with light ore-processing and Steel-type expansion.

B1F_LEFT_ORE_VEIN.identity: Old ore vein; denser mineral, crystal, and digging ecology.

B1F_RIGHT_TRAINING_GALLERY.identity: Trainer-used gallery; Platinum mine anchors remain, but hardy Fighting/Steel species become more common.

B2F_LEFT_RILEY_SECTION.identity: Riley partnership zone; Steelix enters as in Platinum and industrial/mining species become heavier. Wild battles become doubles while Riley accompanies the player.

B2F_RIGHT_IRON_CHAMBER.identity: Iron-rich chamber; fewer basic rocks, more developed Steel species and abandoned-mine specialists.

B3F_FINAL_MINE.identity: Deepest abandoned mine before the exit/ruins; strongest Steel/mineral ecology with Steelix as the major Platinum anchor.

riley.partner_rule: Preserve Platinum structure: Riley joins in B2F; wild battles become Double Battles while partnered and Riley heals the player's party after battles.
riley.gift_note: Riolu is intentionally NOT a random Iron Island encounter. Earlier Mercury access remains intact; Riley's Egg remains a special story reward. If the party is full, Mercury should send the Egg to the PC rather than forcing a backtrack.
riley.galactic_note: Preserve the Platinum Team Galactic encounter that ends Riley's partnership before the Egg reward.

iron_ruins.note: Preserve the Platinum Iron Ruins/Registeel concept as special authored content; do not dilute it with a generic random encounter table. Legendary/static implementation is a later story/content pass.

diversity_rules: Do not use one generic encounter table for every Iron Island floor.
Preserve Platinum's Geodude/Graveler/Zubat/Golbat/Onix/Steelix cave backbone while increasing Steel/mineral specialization with depth.
Riolu stays a Riley gift, not a random encounter, despite earlier Mercury wild availability elsewhere.
Do not reuse Great Marsh Safari-exclusive species as ordinary Iron Island catches.
Iron Island should feel distinct from Oreburgh Mine, Wayward Cave, Ruin Maniac Tunnel, and Mt. Coronet through its abandoned industrial mine / Steel ecology.

design_rules: Preserve Platinum Mt. Coronet anchors such as Clefairy, Golbat, Machoke, Graveler, Nosepass, Medicham, Chingling/Chimecho, Bronzong, Snover, and Abomasnow.
Different Coronet floors must have distinct sub-identities rather than cloning one cave roster at higher levels.
The snowy mountainside uses Morning/Day/Evening/Night turnover because it is outdoors.
B1F Feebas lake keeps Feebas tied to Mt. Coronet but removes the tiny-tile lottery; Feebas is a permanent rare fishing target.
Spear Pillar has no generic random wild encounter table; story/static legendary encounters remain scripted content.

MT_CORONET_B1F_FEEBAS_LAKE.identity: Hidden subterranean lake. Platinum cave anchors remain, but the water/fishing ecology is authored around Barboach/Whiscash and permanent Feebas availability instead of a special-tile lottery.
MT_CORONET_B1F_FEEBAS_LAKE.special_rule: Feebas is always present in the lake's fishing pool. No daily tile roll or hidden 4-tile requirement.

MT_CORONET_ASCENT_2F.identity: First serious post-Galactic-HQ ascent floor; Platinum mineral/fairy/psychic anchors with new crystal and magnetic species.

MT_CORONET_ASCENT_3F.identity: Higher magnetic cavern; evolved psychic/steel and magnetic species become more prominent.

MT_CORONET_MOUNTAINSIDE.identity: Snow-covered exterior between interior ascent chambers. Platinum Snover/Abomasnow and mountain anchors remain; clock-based ecology is meaningful because this section is outdoors.

MT_CORONET_4F_ROOM1_CRYSTAL_GALLERY.identity: Crystal/mineral gallery; mineral Pokémon become much more prominent than on lower floors.

MT_CORONET_4F_ROOM2_WATERFALL_SHRINE.identity: Quiet waterfall/orb chamber; psychic, fairy, ghost, and ancient-feeling species replace some of the heavy mineral emphasis.

MT_CORONET_4F_ROOM3_GALACTIC_TUNNEL.identity: Narrow final interior approach used by Galactic; darker/steel cave species fit the disturbed tunnel environment.

MT_CORONET_5F_CELESTIAL_CHAMBER.identity: High celestial cavern near the summit; Platinum fairy/psychic/steel anchors combine with sun/moon/cosmic species.

MT_CORONET_6F_SUMMIT_GATE.identity: Final cave floor before Spear Pillar; stronger evolved forms signal the summit and late-story difficulty.

SPEAR_PILLAR.identity: Sacred summit ruins and Galactic climax area.
static_policy: Platinum story climax routes into Giratina / Distortion World rather than making Dialga or Palkia ordinary random encounters.
Dialga/Palkia portal encounters, if retained, remain later scripted static encounters tied to their proper orb/story conditions.
Any Mercury-specific legendary additions must be authored as static/story content, never grass/cave random slots.

reference_notes.Feebas source note: In Platinum, Feebas is restricted to four daily-changing fishing tiles in Mt. Coronet B1F; Mercury deliberately removes that tile lottery while keeping Feebas tied to the same lake.

REGI_RUINS_PRELEAGUE_REGISTRY_2026-09-05.scope: Pre-League Legendary Titan ruins: Regirock / Regice / Registeel + Regigigas activation loop
REGI_RUINS_PRELEAGUE_REGISTRY_2026-09-05.design_source: Pokemon Platinum / Sinnoh ruins and seven-dot statue puzzles, adapted only where required to satisfy Mercury pre-League availability
REGI_RUINS_PRELEAGUE_REGISTRY_2026-09-05.source_rule: Platinum/Sinnoh defines each ruin room, puzzle, legendary identity, and story landmark. Emerald-derived engine content is not a design source.

unlock.trigger: After earning the Icicle Badge, Snowpoint Temple becomes explorable before the League. Reaching dormant Regigigas on B5F activates the Titan Tablet story flag.
unlock.titan_tablet: Mercury key-story device replacing Platinum's external/fateful-encounter Regigigas requirement. It activates the seven-dot patterns/statues in all three ruins without requiring an event Pokemon.
unlock.why: Avoids Platinum's circular/event-only access while preserving the original three ruin puzzles and Regigigas requirement.

ROCK_PEAK_RUINS.platinum_identity: Use the Platinum Rock Peak Ruins room, seven floor dots, rear statue, Hard Stone flavor/reward, and Regirock encounter behavior.
ROCK_PEAK_RUINS.mercury_access: The ruin chamber is accessed pre-League from a newly uncovered branch of the Route 214 Ruin Maniac Tunnel rather than requiring postgame Route 228. Only the entrance connection changes; the Rock Peak Ruins room/puzzle remains Platinum-derived.
ROCK_PEAK_RUINS.activation: Titan Tablet active -> step on all seven dots -> tremor -> interact with statue.
ROCK_PEAK_RUINS.respawn: If KOed or fled, Regirock returns after leaving/re-entering the ruin until caught.

ICEBERG_RUINS.platinum_identity: Keep the Platinum Iceberg Ruins inside northern Mt. Coronet near the Route 216 exit, including the seven-dot floor puzzle and statue.
ICEBERG_RUINS.mercury_access: Available pre-League once the Titan Tablet is active; no Hall of Fame, National Dex, or external event Regigigas.
ICEBERG_RUINS.activation: Titan Tablet active -> step on all seven dots -> tremor -> interact with statue.
ICEBERG_RUINS.respawn: If KOed or fled, Regice returns after leaving/re-entering the ruin until caught.

IRON_RUINS.platinum_identity: Keep the Platinum Iron Ruins on Iron Island near the exit, including the seven-dot floor puzzle and statue.
IRON_RUINS.mercury_access: Available pre-League once the Titan Tablet is active; Iron Island remains the canonical location.
IRON_RUINS.activation: Titan Tablet active -> step on all seven dots -> tremor -> interact with statue.
IRON_RUINS.respawn: If KOed or fled, Registeel returns after leaving/re-entering the ruin until caught.

regigigas.requirement: Regirock, Regice, and Registeel must all be in the party.
regigigas.platinum_identity: Preserve Platinum's Level 1 Regigigas gimmick and Snowpoint Temple location.
regigigas.mercury_access: No National Dex or Hall of Fame requirement. Once the trio is caught, return to B5F and interact with dormant Regigigas.
regigigas.respawn: If KOed or fled, Regigigas remains available after leaving/re-entering B5F until caught.

implementation_rules: Do not add generic random encounters inside any of the three Titan Ruins.
Do not open Route 228/Battle Zone early merely to reach Regirock.
Do not require an external event Regigigas, Pal Park transfer, or National Dex.
Use a dedicated story flag/key-item state for Titan Tablet activation; exact item constant may be allocated during final map/script implementation.
Legendary catches are once-per-save after successful capture, but KO/flee must never permanently lose them.
The Regi trio and Regigigas are all obtainable before the Pokemon League.

2F_MAGNETIC_GALLERY.identity: Steel/magnetic upper chamber. Platinum Steelix/Magneton/Gabite core expanded with evolved Steel and Ground species.

B1F_UNDERGROUND_WATER.identity: Underground lake chamber. Platinum Azumarill/Floatzel plus cave anchors preserved, with a distinct Water/Fighting/Dragon expansion.

marley_branch_policy.platinum_reference: Platinum locks the Marley/Route 224 branch behind the National Dex. Mercury must not use that postgame lock because supported Pokemon are intended to be obtainable before the League/postgame.
marley_branch_policy.mercury_policy: Unlock the Marley branch through authored pre-League story/progression when its real Sinnoh map and Route 224 content are built. Keep its encounter tables separate from the main 1F/2F/B1F route.

league_approach.youngster_martin: Final mandatory Youngster Martin battle remains a scripted trainer encounter before the League; this ecology pass does not change his canonical team.

unlock_policy.platinum: The Marley branch opens only after the National Dex / postgame progression in Platinum.

FOG_GALLERY.identity: Platinum Nat Dex Area converted into the pre-League Marley entrance: damp/foggy cave retaining Floatzel, Graveler, Onix, Golbat, Steelix and Gabite, with a stronger nocturnal/mineral expansion.

route_224.identity: Platinum Route 224: remote forested peninsula with beaches and the White Rock, expanded as a pre-League optional high-level route.

platinum_specials_normalized.policy: Mercury folds these Platinum special-method species into authored TOD tables instead of requiring Radar/swarm RNG. GBA-cartridge insertion is not used as a content source.

route_224.white_rock: Preserved as the route endpoint and Shaymin/Seabreak Path story anchor.

white_rock_oaks_letter.platinum: Oak's Letter opens Seabreak Path from the White Rock after the gratitude interaction.

seabreak_path.role: Flower-covered approach to Flower Paradise; preserve Platinum's encounter-free presentation.

flower_paradise.gracidea_policy: Catching the fateful/static Shaymin should unlock the normal Gracidea/Sky Forme path in Mercury; exact NPC/item script is deferred.

ROUTE_221.identity: Platinum wooded Pal Park approach anchored by Sudowoodo/Girafarig/Roselia/Floatzel. Radar Nidorina/Nidorino and swarm Farfetchd are normalized into authored encounters instead of special RNG.

PAL_PARK.identity: Preserve Platinum Pal Park as a special facility rather than inventing a normal grass table. Mercury can later repurpose its migration function, but ordinary route-style encounters are intentionally absent.

remaining_audit_flags: Regirock/Regice/Registeel pre-League access still needs a dedicated Platinum-ruins policy. Registeel Iron Ruins is already reserved on Iron Island; Iceberg Ruins is in Mt. Coronet; Rock Peak Ruins is normally on postgame Route 228 and needs a Mercury pre-League access solution without using external-event Regigigas.
Battle Zone / Routes 225-230 have not been part of the main pre-League encounter pass. No required species may depend on those postgame routes.

SINNOH_SPECIAL_LEGENDARY_AREAS_REGISTRY_.scope: Sendoff Spring / Turnback Cave / lake guardians / Fullmoon Island / Newmoon Island / Dialga-Palkia portal encounter specification
SINNOH_SPECIAL_LEGENDARY_AREAS_REGISTRY_.design_source: Pokemon Platinum / Sinnoh, expanded for Mercury Redux
SINNOH_SPECIAL_LEGENDARY_AREAS_REGISTRY_.source_rule: Platinum/Sinnoh defines geography, encounter anchors, ecology, static encounter staging, and story placement. Emerald-derived engine IDs are hidden implementation infrastructure only and are never content sources.
SINNOH_SPECIAL_LEGENDARY_AREAS_REGISTRY_.runtime_note: The finished Platinum-derived Sendoff Spring, Turnback Cave, Fullmoon Island, Newmoon Island, lake caverns, and late Spear Pillar static-event maps/scripts are not all constructed in this cumulative source. Do not attach these specifications to unrelated engine geography.

SENDOFF_SPRING.identity: Sinnoh's secret fourth lake and the return point from the Distortion World. Platinum anchors Bibarel, Golduck, Staravia/Noctowl and Chimecho remain visible; Mercury adds a restrained liminal Ghost/Psychic layer rather than turning the area into a generic route.
SENDOFF_SPRING.availability: Accessible immediately when the player exits the Distortion World, as in Platinum.
SENDOFF_SPRING.platinum_dual_slot_policy: Solrock/Lunatone are NOT imported from Platinum's GBA dual-slot method. Mercury does not use cartridge-insertion encounter mechanics as a content source.

TURNBACK_CAVE.availability_policy: Mercury removes Platinum's Hall-of-Fame gate. Turnback Cave opens after the Distortion World story resolution and before the League so Giratina retry/Griseous Orb access is never postgame-only.
TURNBACK_CAVE.maze_policy: Preserve Platinum's three-pillar / under-30-room maze identity. Exact room-randomization script is deferred to the final map implementation.

ENTRANCE_TO_FIRST_PILLAR.identity: Outer echo rooms retaining Platinum Gastly/Golbat/Bronzor/Chingling/Duskull anchors.

FIRST_TO_SECOND_PILLAR.identity: Mid-depth rooms where Platinum evolves the core toward Haunter/Bronzong/Chimecho/Dusclops.

SECOND_TO_THIRD_PILLAR.identity: Deep distortion-overlap rooms with stronger evolved Ghost/Psychic/ancient species while retaining the Platinum core.

missed_distortion_retry.condition: Only if Origin Forme Giratina was not captured in the Distortion World

terminal_room.griseous_orb: If Giratina was already caught, completing the Turnback maze grants access to the Distortion World portal / Griseous Orb path. Mercury makes the Griseous Orb obtainable before the League.
terminal_room.origin_form_policy: Captured Giratina uses the Griseous Orb/form-change system outside the Distortion World; no second random Giratina is added.

FULLMOON_ISLAND.platinum_story: Cresselia is met in the crescent clearing, flees, and leaves the Lunar Wing for Sailor Eldritch's son.
FULLMOON_ISLAND.mercury_access: The Canalave nightmare/Lunar Wing sidequest unlocks before the League after the Distortion World/Canalave story requirements; no National Dex or Hall of Fame gate.

first_scene.action: Flees and leaves the Lunar Wing, preserving Platinum's story beat.

cresselia.capture_qol: After the Lunar Wing cures the boy, Cresselia returns to Fullmoon Island as a visible static Lv.60 encounter. Mercury does not require random regional roaming to capture it.

NEWMOON_ISLAND.member_card_policy: Member Card becomes an obtainable in-game key item tied to the completed Lunar Wing/Cresselia nightmare chain. No external distribution, National Dex, or Hall of Fame requirement.
NEWMOON_ISLAND.story: Canalave's locked inn initiates the nightmare transport to Newmoon Island, preserving Platinum's event framing.
NEWMOON_ISLAND.mega_note: Catching Darkrai grants the base species only. Any Darkrai Mega Stone/mega access remains a separate Mercury progression reward and is not bundled into this encounter.

lake_guardians.unlock: After resolving Giratina / Distortion World, as in Platinum.

MESPRIT.platinum_story: Mesprit flees Lake Verity and becomes a roaming Pokémon.
MESPRIT.mercury_qol: Preserve the flee scene, but replace blind random roaming with a Marking Map-guided guaranteed pursuit: the map shows its exact current route and the next eligible encounter/visible marker on that route triggers Mesprit. It cannot be permanently lost.

spear_pillar_portals.unlock_policy: After the Distortion World story, obtaining the Adamant Orb/Lustrous Orb in Mt. Coronet and speaking with Cynthia's grandmother enables the corresponding Spear Pillar portals. Mercury removes Platinum's Hall of Fame/National Dex gate.
spear_pillar_portals.sequence: Both may be caught on the same save; exiting/re-entering Spear Pillar refreshes the next available portal, matching Platinum's sequential portal concept.
